content.title: Next.js Is an Application Framework
content.hook: Before this module, React gave you components, state, effects, routing ideas, and application composition.
content.context:
Now the question changes:

**What does a real application need around React?**

A real application also needs a place for routes, layouts, server work, browser work, loading states, error states, metadata, environment configuration, and a predictable project structure.

Next.js gives you a framework for those concerns.

For this module, use one mental model:

**React describes the interface. Next.js organizes the application around that interface.**

options.text: A framework for routing, application structure, server/client boundaries, and more

feedback.correct: React is the UI library. Next.js is an application framework that organizes routing, rendering, project structure, and server/client behavior around React.
feedback.incorrect: React is the UI library. Next.js is an application framework that organizes routing, rendering, project structure, and server/client behavior around React.

content.title: First comparison
content.text:
Think about these two questions:

**React question:** “How should this UI behave?”

**Next.js question:** “Where does this UI live in the application, how is it reached, where does its code run, and how should the application respond around it?”

That distinction will guide this entire module.

activities.title: What Next.js does not magically solve

content.title: What Next.js does not magically solve
content.text:
A framework can provide defaults and capabilities. It does not make architecture disappear.

You still need to decide:

- where logic belongs,
- what state is local or shared,
- which code needs the browser,
- what should stay on the server,
- how failures should appear,
- and what the user should experience while work is happening.

content.question: Which statement is the strongest mental model?

options.text: Next.js is mostly a styling library.
Next.js provides application structure and server/client capabilities around React.
Next.js means you no longer need JavaScript.

feedback.correct: Correct answer: C. Next.js provides application structure and server/client capabilities around React.
feedback.incorrect: Correct answer: C. Next.js provides application structure and server/client capabilities around React.

content.title: Forge takeaway & Lesson completion
takeaways: Do not ask only, “How do I build this component?”
**“Where does this component belong in the application, and where should its work run?”**
nextSteps: Explain the difference between a UI library and an application framework in your own words. Then apply the distinction to one feature you have already built.
